mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chunk_embedding (kb_id, doc_id, content, metadata, embedding) VALUES (CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), CAST(#{docId} AS uuid), #{content}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{embedding, typeHandler=com.agentforge.typehandler.PgVectorTypeHandler, javaType=float[], jdbcType=OTHER}::vector)
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id::text AS kb_id, doc_id::text AS doc_id, content, metadata::text AS metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM chunk_embedding WHERE kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) ORDER BY embedding <-> CAST(#{queryVector} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}
